guacamaya.escenario: Fly, macaw. Tap or press the space bar to flap.

portada.ayuda: Tap the screen or press the space bar to flap.
portada.reto: Challenge for {fecha}: the same flight for everyone, today.

pausa.texto: The macaw is hovering in place. Tap the screen to keep going.

fin.recogioYLlego: You grabbed {mangos} and made it home with {vidas}.
fin.recogioYFalto: You grabbed {mangos}. You were {segundos} short of home.
fin.guardo: You stashed {n} at home: you now have {total} for plumages.

perdidos.one: This flight's mango was lost: only the ones that make it home are kept.
perdidos.other: This flight's {n} mangoes were lost: only the ones that make it home are kept.

fin.dolar: While you were flying, the BCV official dollar rate stood at {valor}.
fin.llegoJefe: The kid ran out of stones!

compartir.casi: My macaw almost made it home
compartir.texto: {logro} on the flight {destino}, with {mangos}: {puntos} pts in the challenge for {fecha}. Can you beat it?

roja.nota: Red all over, with a yellow wing and blue tips.

pelotera.nota: Cap and ball, no team jersey.

roques.nota: Sunglasses and a float ring. Beach season is coming.

tricolor.nota: With the yellow, blue and red cap and its eight stars.

liqui.nota: Dressed to the nines, with gold buttons and a llanero hat.

catatumbo.nota: Electric blue. With it, the storm lightning changes color.

toro.nota: Bullish. Horns, nose ring and green feathers.

oso.nota: Bearish. For red days on the market.

dolar.nota: Flies with a wad of bills in its claws.

dorada.nota: Leaves a trail of sparkle all across the Ávila.

zamuro.nota: You play as a vulture. The other vultures still hit you.

vuelos.estrellas: Every flight gives up to three stars: get home, get home without a single hit and grab six out of ten mangoes.
vuelos.bloqueado: Get home on flight {n} to unlock it.

caracas.texto: Dusk is falling over the Ávila. Dodge kites, vultures and storms, grab mangoes and get home before dark.
caracas.aviso: Kites, vultures and storms. Take it easy.

barquisimeto.texto: Twilight over the valley, with the Cathedral behind. Now there are pigeons: they come in a V-shaped flock and close in.
barquisimeto.aviso: Flocks of pigeons: go over or under them.

margarita.texto: The coastal breeze brings swarms of bees and gusts that push the macaw. The wind streaks show up before it blows.
margarita.aviso: Gusts: the wind streaks warn you before they push.

zulia.texto: Lake Maracaibo, with its derricks and its stormy sky. Crickets jump up from the road and the oil derricks stand tall.

laguaira.texto: Fast planes cross over the port of La Guaira. A yellow triangle at the edge of the screen shows what height they come in at.
laguaira.aviso: Planes: watch the yellow triangle at the edge.

canaima.texto: The tepuis of Canaima, in the mist. You have to thread between rocks and what's ahead shows up late: pick your height by eye.
canaima.aviso: Rocks and mist: what's far away shows up late.

loma.texto: On top of the hill, a kid with a slingshot wants to knock the macaw down with stones. He raises his arm before every shot and you can see where he's aiming.
loma.aviso: Boss: the dotted line shows where the stone is going.

meta.descripcion: A one-minute game with seven flights over Venezuela, from Caracas to Canaima, and a boss who throws stones. Every day, the same flight for everyone.

pausa.titulo: Between one read and the next, a flight
pausa.entrada: The flight changes every day, and it's the same for everyone. Play, compare your result and get back to reading.

analista.kicker: For when you have more than a minute
analista.texto: A career and investing simulator: thirty years, one year per turn, with decisions that matter, news that shakes the market, a portfolio you allocate yourself and a finance curriculum that grows with your career.

tarjetaPausa.texto: Seven one-minute flights over Venezuela and a new challenge every day. One finger.

banner.kicker: Done reading? Take a one-minute break
banner.titulo: Get the macaw home before dark

meta.descripcion: A career and investing simulator: thirty years, one year per turn, decisions that matter and a portfolio you allocate yourself. With an account, your career counts toward the ranking.

aviso.tituloSinConfirmar: Verify your email to join the ranking
aviso.tituloSinSesion: To join the ranking, sign in to your account
aviso.textoSinConfirmar: We sent you a code when you signed up. Your career is saved and will be recorded automatically as soon as you verify it.
aviso.textoSinSesion: You can keep playing without an account, but only the careers of readers with an account count toward the ranking. Your career is saved and will be recorded automatically when you sign in.

nota.anotada: Your career has been recorded in the ranking.
nota.fallo: We couldn't record your career. Finish another one and try again.
nota.confirme: Verify your email and your career will be recorded automatically.

barra.entreParaSumar: Sign in to join the ranking
barra.suman: Your careers count toward the ranking
